title: Hedgehog Concept
equation: Hedgehog Score = min(Passion, Best-at-it, Economic Engine)
hook: Loving it isn't enough. Being good at it isn't enough. It also has to make money.
statement: Focus where what you love, what you can be best at, and what drives your profit all overlap.
explainer: The hard part is saying no to exciting ideas that sit outside that overlap. Businesses that strip away everything else tend to outperform the ones chasing every good opportunity.
sop: Score Passion, Best-at-it, and Economic Engine honestly from 1 to 10.
Stop or shrink projects that fall outside it.
Re-test the three circles every year.
equation_example: Passion 8, Best-at-it 5, Economic Engine 9. This is an overlap, not a product, so your Hedgehog Score is the lowest of the three: 5. High across all three means real focus. One low score means you're forcing a fit that isn't there.
question: Write down the one thing that sits inside all three circles for you right now.
closing_statement: The overlap is the only sustainable place to work.
caption:
Principle Nº 273: Hedgehog Concept

Loving it isn't enough. Being good at it isn't enough. It also has to make money.

Focus where what you love, what you can be best at, and what drives your profit all overlap.
